title: Magical Fruit
description: MagicFruits – 12 Unique Mythical Fruits with Abilities & Spin System.
body:
**MagicFruits** brings a completely new gameplay layer to your Minecraft server.  
Collect, spin, and master 12 legendary fruits – each with its own right‑click and crouch‑right‑click abilities.

[🔺ISSUES](https://discord.gg/PYYrY9Jdg)


[**For more details**](https://discord.gg/CJgYymgAr)

---

## ✨ Features

### 🍎 12 Unique Fruits
| Fruit | Primary Ability | Secondary Ability |
|-------|----------------|-------------------|
| **Cyclone Fury** | Dash with 10x speed, launch enemies | Summon a tornado that sucks up blocks & slams them |
| **Tsunami** | Water geysers that launch entities skyward | Transform into a devastating tsunami wave |
| **Dracula Bites** | Blood Phase – every 3rd hit heals you | Become a bat, fly freely and bite enemies |
| **Nature Hammer** | Hook & control a player, then launch them | Summon an oak hammer that smashes enemies |
| **Void** | Invisibility + night vision | Random teleport with particles |
| **Thunder** | Conduit power + dolphin's grace | Strike lightning at targeted block |
| **Throne** | Damage‑reflecting shield (50% reduction) | Summon a 3x3 obsidian wall with knockback |
| **Wind Monster** | Float & auto‑slam 5x5 area (wind version) | Same but with electric damage & lightning |
| **Star** | Supernova – orbiting stars, beams, area damage | Black hole – pulls & crushes enemies |
| **Thief** | GUI to steal another player’s ability | Freeze everyone within 30 blocks (2 min cooldown) |
| **Portal** | Create two portals (15s to connect) | Summon a portal that lets you call any online player |
| **Buddha** | Strength + resistance | Temporary invulnerability |

### 🎡 Spin System
- New players get a **free spin** (toggable).
- Admins can start spins for **self, specific player, or all players**.
- 15‑second spinning animation with **particles and floating item previews**.
- Random fruit reward – shown with a fancy title and sound.

### 🎮 Admin Dashboard
- One‑click GUI to **give fruits**, **manage spins**, **reset player data**.
- Toggle **first‑join reward** on/off.
- Toggle **drop‑on‑death** on/off.
- Adjust cooldown duration & spin duration.
- Enable/disable particles and sounds.

### 🔥 Advanced Mechanics
- **Separate cooldowns** for primary/secondary abilities.
- **XP bar + action bar** cooldown timer.
- **CustomModelData** support – ready for resource packs.
- **Grace period** command – protect new players during events.
- **100% Paper 1.21.4** – uses latest API.

---

## 📦 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/magicfruits` | Open admin dashboard |
| `/magicfruits spin [player/all]` | Start fruit spin |
| `/magicfruits give <player> <fruit>` | Give a specific fruit |
| `/magicfruits reset <player/all>` | Reset player data |
| `/magicfruits grace start <minutes>` | Start grace period |
| `/magicfruits grace stop` | End grace period |
| `/magicfruits reload` | Reload config |

Permissions: `magicfruits.admin` (default OP)

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download the **JAR** file.
2. Place it in your server’s `plugins` folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. (Optional) Install **CIT_reborn** or **CIT Resewn** and add the included resource pack for custom fruit textures.

Perfect for servers that want a premium, unique look.

- **Paper 1.21-1.21.11** (Spigot may work but not officially tested)
